 Argentina will take the field since Lionel Messi’s international retirement for just the second time when it faces Costa Rica in an international friendly on Tuesday.
 Argentina succumbed to a 1-2 loss against Uruguay last time out, and will aim to bounce back as the Lionel Scaloni coached-side looks to move on from the Messi era.
 Costa Rica too will enter the contest on the back of a 0-2 loss against Ecuador. Argentina is unbeaten against Costa Rica in their previous three meetings.
 In the last game between the two sides in 2024, Argentina won 3-1. Angel Di Maria (52nd minute), Alexis Mac Allister (56th minute), and Lautaro Martinez (77th minute) were the goal-scorers for La Albiceleste .
 When is the Argentina vs Costa Rica international friendly? 
 The Argentina vs Costa Rica international friendly is scheduled to take place at 4:30 AM IST on November 18, Wednesday at the Estadio Mario Alberto Kempes in Cordoba, Argentina. In the last match between the two sides in this venue, Argentina won 3-0 in the Round of 16 in the Copa America in 2011.
 Where will the Argentina vs Costa Rica international friendly be streamed live? 
 The Argentina vs Costa Rica international friendly will not be streamed live in India. Fans in USA can watch the game live on ViX, Prime Video USA in
